occupations.definition: Industrial investigator investigates and determines facts in connection with spurious goods at the request of manufacturing companies or establishments. He/she investigates source of goods known to be imitations and makes detailed reports to his/her employers.

occupations.title: Insurance investigator
occupations.definition: Insurance investigator investigates, analyses, and determines the facts in connection with spurious claims at the request of insurance companies. He/she corresponds with or interviews medical specialists, agents, witnesses, or claimants to compile information.

occupations.title: Park ranger
occupations.definition: Park ranger supervises and coordinates activities of workers engaged in silvi-cultural work in park ranges. He/she supervises the silvi-cultural work such as poison-girdling, planting thinning and enumeration of trees in a specific park range.

occupations.title: Other protective services and related worker n.e.c.
occupations.definition: This group covers other protective services and related worker not elsewhere classified.

occupations.title: Services worker n.e.c.
occupations.definition: This group covers services worker not elsewhere classified.

occupations.title: Vegetable farm worker
occupations.definition: Vegetable farm worker performs farming operations to grow and harvest various types of field crops such as rice and other cereals, beetroot, sugarcane, groundnuts, tobacco, reed or other field crops and potatoes, cabbages or other field vegetables, for sale or delivery on a regular basis to wholesale buyers, marketing organisations or at markets.

occupations.title: Landscape/Plant nursery supervisor
occupations.definition: Landscape/Plant nursery supervisor plans work schedules and assigns duties to gardeners, horticultural and nursery workers. He/she implements plant propagation practices, and maintains and monitors production systems in addition to ensuring that plants are in the optimal condition for sale or delivery for landscape projects.

occupations.title: Plant nursery worker
occupations.definition: Plant nursery worker operates a plant nursery to cultivate and maintain trees, shrubs, flowers and other plants for sale or delivery for landscape projects. He/she performs tasks such as plant propagation, watering, pruning, fertilising, and pest or disease treatment.

occupations.title: Gardener/Horticultural worker
occupations.definition: Gardener/Horticultural worker performs operations work in nurseries or greenhouses for the production of horticultural crops. He/she cultivates flowers, trees, shrubs and other plants in parks or in public or private gardens.

occupations.title: Livestock/Dairy farm worker
occupations.definition: Livestock/Dairy farm worker breeds and raises domesticated animals (excluding poultry), such as cattle, sheep, pigs, goats, horses and camels, for the production of meat, milk and other dairy products, skins and wool or for use as working, sporting or recreational animals, for sale or delivery to wholesale buyers, marketing organisations or at markets.

occupations.title: Poultry farm worker
occupations.definition: Poultry farm worker performs farming operations to breed and raise poultry for eggs or meat. He/she specialises in raising poultry, such as fowls, ducks, geese and turkeys. He/she may also collect semen from roosters and fertilise hens to obtain hatching eggs.

occupations.title: Agricultural worker n.e.c.
occupations.definition: This group covers agricultural worker not elsewhere classified.

occupations.title: Fish/Prawn farm worker
occupations.definition: Fish/Prawn farm worker performs a variety of tasks in the breeding and raising of fishes and prawns. He/she obtains and hatches fish eggs or buys young fish (fry) from fish hatcheries. He/she collects, sorts and markets fishes and prawns for food or for stocking rivers, lakes and other fishing grounds.

occupations.title: Aquarium fish farm worker
occupations.definition: Aquarium fish farm worker breeds and raises aquarium fish for sale. He/she buys young fish (fry) and transfers fry to aquariums and provides required foods. He/she collects, sorts and packs aquarium fish for sale.

occupations.title: Aquaculture worker n.e.c.
occupations.definition: This group covers aquaculture worker not elsewhere classified.

unit_groups.title: Coastal Waters and Deep Sea Fishery Workers

occupations.title: Coastal waters/Deep sea fishery worker
occupations.definition: Coastal waters/Deep sea fishery worker, alone, or either as skipper or member of fishing crews, catches fish or gathers other forms of aquatic life in deep sea, inland or coastal waters for sale or delivery to wholesale buyers, marketing organisations or at markets.

sub_major_groups.title: BUILDING AND RELATED TRADES WORKERS (EXCLUDING ELECTRICIANS)

minor_groups.title: SUPERVISORS AND GENERAL FOREMEN (BUILDING AND RELATED TRADES)

unit_groups.title: Supervisors and General Foremen (Building and Related Trades)

occupations.title: Supervisor/General foreman (building and related trades)
occupations.definition: Supervisor/General foreman (building and related trades) supervises activities of a distinct unit at a construction site, controls and coordinates the activities of workers who are engaged in various occupations.

minor_groups.title: BUILDING FRAME AND RELATED TRADES WORKERS

occupations.title: Bricklayer/Blocklayer
occupations.definition: Bricklayer/Blocklayer lays bricks, pre-cut stones and other types of building stones in mortar to construct and repair walls, partitions, arches and other structures.

unit_groups.title: Stonemasons, Stone Cutters, Splitters and Carvers

occupations.title: Stonemason/Stone cutter/splitter/carver
occupations.definition: Stonemason/Stone cutter/splitter/carver cuts and shapes hard and soft stone blocks and slabs for the construction and maintenance of stone structures and monumental masonry and carves designs and figures in stones.

unit_groups.title: Concrete Placers, Concrete Finishers and Related Workers

occupations.title: Concrete form worker
occupations.definition: Concrete form worker builds, assembles, places in position and dismantles rough wooden structures (shuttering) into which concrete is poured and allowed to set. He/she marks out, cuts and adjusts wood to be assembled in shuttering partitions or assembles shuttering from prefabricated wooden parts.
exclusions: Concrete finishing machine operator (road paving), see 83429

occupations.title: Cement finisher/Screeder
occupations.definition: Cement finisher/Screeder finishes surfaces of concrete structures and smooths surfaces of freshly poured concrete sections. He/she cuts ridges, bumps and projecting wire from concrete surface with chisel and hammer. He/she patches holes and broken corners by wetting them.

occupations.title: Concrete placer/finisher and related worker n.e.c.
occupations.definition: This group covers concrete placer/finisher and related worker not elsewhere classified.
exclusions: Road surface laying machine operator, see 83429

occupations.title: Carpenter
occupations.definition: Carpenter cuts out, assembles, erects and repairs structural and other woodwork at work bench or on construction site. He/she works from plans, sketches or instructions received and marks out reference points accordingly to facilitate cutting and shaping.

occupations.title: Joiner
occupations.definition: Joiner fits, assembles and installs wooden internal and external fixtures of buildings such as door and window frames, facings and panelling in workshop or on site. He/she may make parts of woodwork.

unit_groups.title: Building Frame and Related Trades Workers Not Elsewhere Classified

occupations.title: Scaffolder
occupations.definition: Scaffolder erects temporary metal or wooden scaffolding on building sites for construction, renovation, exterior painting and similar purposes. He/she fixes upright members in place and secures horizontal members to uprights to support platforms.

occupations.title: Cladding/Curtain wall erector
occupations.definition: Cladding/Curtain wall erector installs cladding and curtain wall for the external walls of buildings.

occupations.title: Other building frame and related trades worker n.e.c.
occupations.definition: This group covers other building frame and related trades worker not elsewhere classified.

minor_groups.title: BUILDING FINISHERS AND RELATED TRADES WORKERS

occupations.title: Roofer
occupations.definition: Roofer builds and repairs roofs on all types of buildings using one or more kinds of materials. He/she builds, repairs and covers roofs of structures with shingles, slate, asphalt, aluminium, wood, or related materials. He/she may spray roofs, sidings, and walls with material to bind, seal, insulate, or soundproof sections of structures.

occupations.title: Floor/Wall tiler
occupations.definition: Floor/Wall tiler installs, maintains and repairs flooring, and covers floors, walls and other surfaces with tiles or mosaic panels for decorative or other purposes. He/she cuts tiles to the right size and shape, prepares the surface, and puts the tiles in place flush and straight.

occupations.title: Plasterer
occupations.definition: Plasterer installs, maintains and repairs plasterboard in buildings, and applies decorative and protective coverings of plaster, cement and similar material to the interiors and exteriors of structures. He/she applies one or more coats of plaster to interior walls and ceilings of buildings to produce a finished surface.

occupations.title: Refrigeration/Air-conditioning equipment insulator
occupations.definition: Refrigeration/Air-conditioning equipment insulator applies and repairs insulating materials to buildings, boilers, pipes or refrigeration and air-conditioning equipment. He/she examines plans, specifications and work sites to determine the type, quality and quantity of insulation material required.

occupations.title: Boiler/Pipe insulator
occupations.definition: Boiler/Pipe insulator applies insulating material such as asbestos, cork, felt or mineral wool to exposed surfaces of equipment such as boilers, pipes and tanks.

occupations.title: Insulation worker n.e.c.
occupations.definition: This group covers insulation worker not elsewhere classified.

occupations.title: Glazier
occupations.definition: Glazier measures, cuts, finishes, fits and installs flat glass and mirrors. He/she cuts glass with cutting tool according to pattern or outline and smooths rough edges.

unit_groups.title: Plumbers, Pipe Fitters and Related Workers

occupations.title: Plumber
occupations.definition: Plumber assembles, installs and maintains pipes, fittings and fixtures of drainage, heating, water supply and sanitary systems. He/she examines drawings and other specifications, locates and marks position of pipe and pipe connections and passage holes for pipes in walls and floors.

occupations.title: Pipe fitter
occupations.definition: Pipe fitter assembles, installs and maintains high-pressure and low-pressure systems of metal pipes for conducting air, gas, steam, oil, water and other fluids. He/she finds and repairs leaks, joints, couplings and other fittings.

occupations.title: Pipe/Drain layer
occupations.definition: Pipe/Drain layer lays pipes of glazed and unglazed clay, concrete, cast-iron and other materials in ditches to form sewers, drains, water mains and conduits for cables and other purposes. He/she smooths bottom of ditch to proper level and cuts out place for bell end of pipe.

occupations.title: Air-conditioning/Refrigeration equipment mechanic
occupations.definition: Air-conditioning/Refrigeration equipment mechanic maintains and repairs industrial, commercial and domestic air-conditioning and refrigeration systems and equipment.
exclusions: Aircraft pipe and tube fitter, see 71262

occupations.title: Air-conditioning/Refrigeration plant installer
occupations.definition: Air-conditioning/Refrigeration plant installer installs residential central air-conditioning systems, commercial and industrial refrigeration and air-conditioning systems.

unit_groups.title: Building Finishers and Related Trades Workers Not Elsewhere Classified

occupations.title: Building finisher and related trades worker n.e.c.
occupations.definition: This group covers building finisher and related trades worker not elsewhere classified.

minor_groups.title: PAINTERS, BUILDING STRUCTURE CLEANERS AND RELATED WORKERS

occupations.title: Building painter
occupations.definition: Building painter paints walls, equipment, buildings, bridges, and other structural surfaces, using brushes, rollers, and spray guns. He/she may remove old paint to prepare surface prior to painting and mix colours or oils to obtain the desired colour or consistency.

occupations.title: Wall/Ceiling paperhanger
occupations.definition: Wall/Ceiling paperhanger covers interior walls and ceilings of buildings with wallpaper. He/she removes old paper with scraper, water and chemicals, and also cleans surface, fills cracks and holes with plaster and brushes sizing on surfaces.

unit_groups.title: Spray Painters, Varnishers and Related Painters

occupations.title: Structural steel/Ship painter
occupations.definition: Structural steel/Ship painter applies coatings of paint, red lead, bituminous emulsion and similar protective materials on bridges, ships’ hulls and metal superstructure, steel framework of buildings, storage tanks and other metal structures. He/she rigs up scaffolding, cradles, ladders and other equipment, and scrapes dirt, rust or scale from surface to be painted.
exclusions: Spray painter (excluding ships and motor vehicles), see 71323

occupations.title: Motor vehicle spray painter
occupations.definition: Motor vehicle spray painter paints automotive vehicles such as automobiles, buses and trucks. He/she removes paint from vehicle or damaged parts using paint solvent and scraper, applies base coating and rubs it down to smooth surface.
exclusions: Spray painter (excluding ships and motor vehicles), see 71323

occupations.title: Spray painter (excluding ships and motor vehicles)
occupations.definition: Spray painter (excluding ships and motor vehicles) applies decorative and protective coatings of paint, enamel and lacquer on metal, wooden and other manufactured articles with a hand-spraying device. He/she selects and mixes paints to obtain the desired colour, and pours coating material into tank of spraying device.

occupations.title: Spray painter/Varnisher and related painter n.e.c.
occupations.definition: This group covers spray painter/varnisher and related painter not elsewhere classified.

unit_groups.title: Building Maintenance Workers, Building Structure Cleaners and Related Workers

occupations.title: Building maintenance worker
occupations.definition: Building maintenance worker keeps structures such as office buildings, apartment houses, hotels and factory buildings in good condition. He/she performs concreting, bricklaying, carpentry, painting and other construction maintenance duties, and replaces defective electrical switches and other fixtures.

occupations.title: Building structure cleaner and related worker
occupations.definition: Building structure cleaner and related worker cleans and refurbishes building exteriors, carpets, chimneys, industrial equipment, ventilation systems, windows and other surfaces, using specialised equipment and techniques.

sub_major_groups.title: METAL, MACHINERY AND RELATED TRADES WORKERS

minor_groups.title: SUPERVISORS AND GENERAL FOREMEN (METAL, MACHINERY AND RELATED TRADES)

unit_groups.title: Supervisors and General Foremen (Metal, Machinery and Related Trades)

occupations.title: Supervisor/General foreman (metal/machinery and related trades)
occupations.definition: Supervisor/General foreman (metal/machinery and related trades) supervises production activities within a distinct unit of an establishment concerned with fabrication of metal products, preparation and erection of metal structures, or fitting and installing mechanical, and controls and coordinates the activities of workers in various occupations.
examples: Non-electronic machinery manufacturing and repair supervisor

minor_groups.title: SHEET AND STRUCTURAL METAL WORKERS, MOULDERS AND WELDERS AND RELATED TRADES WORKERS

occupations.title: Metal moulder/coremaker
occupations.definition: Metal moulder/coremaker makes moulds and cores for casting metal.

occupations.title: Welder/Flame cutter
occupations.definition: Welder/Flame cutter welds and cuts metal parts using gas flame, electric arc and other sources of heat to melt and cut, or to melt and fuse metal.

occupations.title: Sheet metal worker
occupations.definition: Sheet metal worker makes, installs and repairs articles and parts of articles made out of sheet metal such as sheet steel, copper, tin, brass, aluminium, zinc or galvanised iron.

occupations.title: Structural metal preparer/erector
occupations.definition: Structural metal preparer/erector assembles, erects and dismantles structural metal frames of buildings and other structures.

occupations.title: Rigger/Cable splicer
occupations.definition: Rigger/Cable splicer assembles rigging gear to move and position equipment and structural components, or to install and maintain cables, ropes and wires on construction sites, buildings or other structures.

minor_groups.title: BLACKSMITHS, TOOLMAKERS AND RELATED TRADES WORKERS

occupations.title: Blacksmith/Hammersmith/Forging-press worker
occupations.definition: Blacksmith/Hammersmith/Forging-press worker hammers and forges bars, rods or ingots of iron, steel and other metals to make and repair various kinds of tools, equipment and other articles, sets machine tools for operators or sets and operates various machine tools and polishes and sharpens surfaces.

occupations.title: Tool/Die maker
occupations.definition: Tool/Die maker fits and assembles parts to make and repair metal-working dies, cutting tools, jig, fixtures, gauges, and machinists’ hand tools. He/she studies drawings, models and other specifications, computes dimensions, plans layout and assembly operations.

occupations.title: Locksmith
occupations.definition: Locksmith assembles, installs and repairs locks. He/she examines lock parts to check accuracy of fit; chisels, files, scrapes and does other supplementary tooling to correct inaccuracies.

occupations.title: Toolmaker and related worker n.e.c.
occupations.definition: This group covers toolmaker and related worker not elsewhere classified.

unit_groups.title: Metal Polishers, Wheel Grinders and Tool Sharpeners

occupations.title: Metal polisher/Wheel grinder/Tool sharpener
occupations.definition: Metal polisher/Wheel grinder/Tool sharpener polishes and grinds metal surfaces and sharpens tools.
examples: Metal buffing and polishing machine operator

occupations.title: Automotive mechanic
occupations.definition: Automotive mechanic fits, installs, maintains, services and repairs engines and the mechanical and related equipment of passenger cars, delivery trucks, motorcycles and other motor vehicles.

occupations.title: Aircraft engine mechanic/repairer
occupations.definition: Aircraft engine mechanic/repairer fits, services, repairs and overhauls aircraft engines and assemblies, such as airframes, hydraulic, and pneumatic systems.

occupations.title: Rolling stock mechanic
occupations.definition: Rolling stock mechanic fits, installs, examines, services and repairs rolling stock equipment and engines.
examples: Internal combustion engine fitter (excluding aircraft and marine engine)

occupations.title: Bicycle and related repairer
occupations.definition: Bicycle and related repairer fits, maintains, services and repairs the mechanical and related equipment of bicycles, rickshaws, baby carriages, wheelchairs and similar non-motorised transport equipment.

occupations.title: Marine engine mechanic/repairer
occupations.definition: Marine engine mechanic/repairer fits, installs, examines, services and repairs marine equipment and engines.

unit_groups.title: Machinery Mechanics, Fitters and Repairers Not Elsewhere Classified

occupations.title: Machinery mechanic/fitter/repairer n.e.c.
occupations.definition: This group covers machinery mechanic/fitter/repairer not elsewhere classified.

sub_major_groups.title: PRECISION, HANDICRAFT, PRINTING AND RELATED TRADES WORKERS

minor_groups.title: SUPERVISORS AND GENERAL FOREMEN (PRECISION, HANDICRAFT, PRINTING AND RELATED TRADES)

unit_groups.title: Supervisors and General Foremen (Precision, Handicraft, Printing and Related Trades)

occupations.title: Supervisor/General foreman (precision/handicraft/printing and related trades)
occupations.definition: Supervisor/General foreman (precision/handicraft/printing and related trades) supervises production activities within a distinct unit of an establishment in which precision instruments, musical instruments, jewellery, pottery and glass products are fabricated, or within a unit specialising in typesetting and related work in a printing establishment, and control and coordinate the activities of workers in various occupations.

occupations.title: Watch/Clock assembler/repairer
occupations.definition: Watch/Clock assembler/repairer fits, assembles and polishes parts of watches and clocks in addition to checking them for accuracy of fit. He/she repairs, cleans and adjusts watches and clocks, and examines timepieces through magnifying lenses to discover defects. He/she removes and dismantle the clock or watch movements, cleans and lubricates parts, reassembles the movement and regulates it.

occupations.title: Optical instrument maker/repairer
occupations.definition: Optical instrument maker/repairer reads blueprints and assembly drawings to assemble lenses and optical instruments, such as microscopes, telescopes, projection equipment, and medical diagnostic equipment. He/she processes, grinds, polishes, and coats glass materials, centre lenses according to the optical axis, and cements them to the optical frame.

occupations.title: Medical device assembler/repairer
occupations.definition: Medical device assembler/repairer tests, adjusts, or repairs biomedical or electromedical equipment.

occupations.title: Precision instrument maker/repairer n.e.c.
occupations.definition: This group covers precision instrument maker/repairer not elsewhere classified.

unit_groups.title: Musical Instrument Makers, Repairers and Tuners

occupations.title: Musical instrument maker/repairer/tuner
occupations.definition: Musical instrument maker/repairer/tuner makes, assembles, repairs, adjusts, restores musical instruments and tunes them to the required pitch with hand or power tools. He/she usually specialises in one type of instrument, such as string instruments, brass instruments, pianos, reed instruments or percussion instruments.

occupations.title: Jewellery/Precious metal worker
occupations.definition: Jewellery/Precious metal worker designs, fabricates, adjusts, repairs, or appraises jewellery, ceremonial or religious items, gold, silver, other precious metals or gems. He/she cuts, files, polishes and sets precious and semi-precious stones including gems and diamonds and engraves designs on jewellery and precious metal articles. He/she cuts and polishes diamonds for industrial purposes.

occupations.title: Potter and related worker
occupations.definition: Potter and related worker prepares pottery, porcelain ware, sanitary ware, bricks, tiles and abrasive wheels by hand or by machine.

unit_groups.title: Glass Makers, Cutters, Grinders and Finishers

occupations.title: Glass maker/cutter/grinder/finisher
occupations.definition: Glass maker/cutter/grinder/finisher blows, moulds, presses, cuts, trims, grinds and polishes glass, shapes molten glass according to patterns.

unit_groups.title: Sign Writers, Decorative Painters, Engravers and Etchers

occupations.title: Sign writer/Decorative painter/Engraver/Etcher
occupations.definition: Sign writer/Decorative painter/Engraver/Etcher decorates articles made of wood, metal, textiles, glass, ceramics and other materials. He/she plans, lays out and paints letters, figures, monograms and designs to make signs and to engrave and etch ornamental and floral designs on glass and other articles. He/she may also mark outlines of letters and designs directly on surface to be painted, or transfer outline from paper to surface to be painted.
exclusions: Spray painter (excluding ships and motor vehicles), see 71323

occupations.title: Pre-press trades worker
occupations.definition: Pre-press trades worker proofs, formats, sets and composes text and graphics into a form suitable for use in various printing processes and representation in other visual media.

occupations.title: Printer
occupations.definition: Printer sets up and operates digital, letterpress, lithographic, flexographic, gravure, newspaper and other printing presses.

minor_groups.title: SUPERVISORS AND GENERAL FOREMEN (ELECTRICAL AND ELECTRONIC TRADES)

unit_groups.title: Supervisors and General Foremen (Electrical and Electronic Trades)

occupations.title: Lift supervisor
occupations.definition: Lift supervisor supervises lift, escalator and related equipment maintenance, response and recovery, replacement and upgrading activities. He/she conducts risk assessment, develops and conducts safety and technical training and writes reports and resolves disputes.

occupations.title: Supervisor/General foreman (electrical/electronic trades, excluding lift)
occupations.definition: Supervisor/General foreman (electrical/electronic trades, excluding lift) supervises production activities within a distinct unit of an establishment concerned with electrical or electronic machinery and equipment, and controls and coordinates the activities of workers in various occupations.
examples: Electrical and electronic installation and repair (excluding lift) general foreman
Electrical and electronic installation and repair (excluding lift) supervisor

occupations.title: Electrician
occupations.definition: Electrician installs, maintains and repairs electrical wiring systems and related equipment and fixtures.

occupations.title: Electrical fitter
occupations.definition: Electrical fitter fits, adjusts, assembles and repairs various kinds of electrical machinery and electrical apparatus in factory, workshop or place of use. He/she examines wiring and assembly diagrams and other specifications, and checks parts for accuracy of fit and if necessary chisels, files, scrapes and does other supplementary tooling.

occupations.title: Electrical lift/escalator and related equipment fitter
occupations.definition: Electrical lift/escalator and related equipment fitter assembles, installs, repairs, or maintains electric or hydraulic freight or passenger elevators, escalators, or dumbwaiters. He/she fits, adjusts and repairs electrical parts of lifts, escalators and equipment in factory, workshop or place of use.

occupations.title: Electrical household appliance repairer
occupations.definition: Electrical household appliance repairer repairs simple electrical apparatus, mainly of a domestic kind, in workshop or place of use. He/she diagnoses faults with aid of electrical testing equipment and dismantles or partly dismantles equipment if necessary.

occupations.title: Electrical line installer (overhead)
occupations.definition: Electrical line installer (overhead) constructs and repairs overhead high-tension or low-tension power lines conducting electricity between generating stations, substations and consumers. He/she climbs poles and pylons and fixes insulators, lightning arresters and other equipment. He/she also strings cables between pylons, poles and buildings, ensuring that proper sag is left in cables to avoid breakage under changing atmospheric conditions.

occupations.title: Electric cable jointer
occupations.definition: Electric cable jointer makes joints in surface and underground cables. He/she joins and solders corresponding conductor wires, dries out moisture and wraps joints with insulating material.

occupations.title: Underground electrical line installer/repairer
occupations.definition: Underground electrical line installer/repairer constructs, maintains and repairs underground electrical power transmission and distribution systems.

minor_groups.title: ELECTRONICS AND TELECOMMUNICATIONS RELATED TRADES WORKERS

occupations.title: Electronics fitter (excluding broadcasting and communication equipment)
occupations.definition: Electronics fitter (excluding broadcasting and communication equipment) fits, adjusts and repairs various kinds of electronic equipment in factory, workshop or place of use. He/she examines drawings and wiring diagrams, and checks parts for accuracy of fit and, where necessary, files, chisels, scrapes and does other supplementary tooling.

unit_groups.title: Information and Communications Technology Installers and Servicers

occupations.title: Consumer audio/video equipment/radar broadcasting/transmitting equipment fitter/mechanic
occupations.definition: Consumer audio/video equipment/radar broadcasting/transmitting equipment fitter/mechanic fits, adjusts, installs and repairs radio, television, transmitters, receivers and radar equipment in factory, workshop or place of use. He/she specialises in television transmitters/receivers, radar equipment, radio transmitters/receivers and two way radio communications equipment. He/she examines drawings and wiring diagrams, and diagnoses faults with aid of testing equipment.
examples: Television and radio receiving set mechanic

occupations.title: Computer and related electronic equipment mechanic
occupations.definition: Computer and related electronic equipment mechanic fits, adjusts and repairs computers and related electronic equipment in factory, workshop or place of use. He/she specialises in computers and related electronic equipment.
examples: Electronic computer and related equipment fitter

occupations.title: Telecommunications lineman
occupations.definition: Telecommunications lineman installs and repairs overhead, underground and submarine wires and cables for telephone and telecommunications transmission, attaching terminal boxes, repeaters and other specialised equipment to poles. He/she installs auxiliary equipment such as terminal boxes and repeaters and makes connections to complete underground telephone and telecommunications cable systems.

occupations.title: Telecommunications installer/servicer
occupations.definition: Telecommunications installer/servicer installs and repairs telephone and telecommunications equipment. He/she examines drawing and wiring diagrams, and installs or services telephone switchboards, relay racks, dial-switching equipment, receiving sets, telegraphic typewriters and other equipment in position.

sub_major_groups.title: FOOD PROCESSING, WOODWORKING, GARMENT, LEATHER AND OTHER CRAFT AND RELATED TRADES WORKERS

minor_groups.title: SUPERVISORS AND GENERAL FOREMEN (FOOD PROCESSING, WOODWORKING, GARMENT, LEATHER AND RELATED TRADES)

unit_groups.title: Supervisors and General Foremen (Food Processing, Woodworking, Garment, Leather and Related Trades)

occupations.title: Supervisor/General foreman (food processing/woodworking/garment/leather and related trades)
occupations.definition: Supervisor/General foreman (food processing/woodworking/garment/leather and related trades) supervises production activities within a distinct unit of an establishment in which specific knowledge and skills are used for processing foodstuffs and beverages, preparation of fibres, treatment of wood, manufacture of wooden furniture, fur articles, made-to-order garments, footwear and leather goods, and controls and coordinates the activities of workers in various occupations.
examples: Furniture and related products manufacturing supervisor

minor_groups.title: FOOD PROCESSING AND RELATED TRADES WORKERS

unit_groups.title: Butchers, Fishmongers and Related Food Preparers

occupations.title: Butcher/Fishmonger and related food preparer
occupations.definition: Butcher/Fishmonger and related food preparer slaughters animals, cleans, cuts and dresses meat and fish, removes bones and prepares related food items or preserves meat, fish and other foods and food products by drying, salting or smoking.

occupations.title: Baker
occupations.definition: Baker produces finished baked goods, such as bread, cake, and biscuits. He/she also weighs out ingredients and ensures all baking equipment and baking area are clean prior to and post production of any baked items.

occupations.title: Pastry/Confectionery maker
occupations.definition: Pastry/Confectionery maker makes tarts, cakes and other pastry products. He/she also weighs out ingredients and ensures all confectionery equipment and cooking area are clean prior to and post production of any pastry and confectionery items.

unit_groups.title: Food and Beverage Tasters and Graders

occupations.title: Food and beverage taster/grader
occupations.definition: Food and beverage taster/grader inspects, tastes and grades various types of agricultural products, food and beverages.

unit_groups.title: Food Processing and Related Trades Workers Not Elsewhere Classified

occupations.title: Food processing and related trades worker n.e.c.
occupations.definition: This group covers food processing and related trades worker not elsewhere classified.

minor_groups.title: WOOD TREATERS, CABINET MAKERS AND RELATED TRADES WORKERS

occupations.title: Wood treater
occupations.definition: Wood treater operates and tends wood treatment processing equipment and machines to remove bark from logs, produces wood chips, seasons, preserves and treats wood, and produces waferboards, particleboards, hardboards, insulation boards, plywood, veneers and similar wood products.

unit_groups.title: Cabinet Makers and Wood Related Trades Workers

occupations.title: Cabinet maker/Wood related trades worker
occupations.definition: Cabinet maker/Wood related trades worker makes, decorates and repairs wooden furniture, carts and other vehicles, wheels, parts, fittings, patterns, models and other wooden products using woodworking machines, machine tools and specialised hand tools.

unit_groups.title: Furniture Makers and Related Trades Workers Not Elsewhere Classified

occupations.title: Furniture maker and related trades worker n.e.c.
occupations.definition: This group covers furniture maker and related trades worker not elsewhere classified.

minor_groups.title: GARMENT, LEATHER AND RELATED TRADES WORKERS

occupations.title: Tailor/Dressmaker
occupations.definition: Tailor/Dressmaker fabricates, fits, alters and repairs tailored or hand-made clothing. He/she produces made-to-measure clothing such as suits, overcoats, and dresses from textile fabrics, and other material, according to customers’ and clothing manufacturers’ specifications.

unit_groups.title: Garment and Related Pattern-Makers and Cutters

occupations.title: Garment and related pattern-maker/cutter
occupations.definition: Garment and related pattern-maker/cutter creates precision master patterns for production of garments, other textiles, and leather or fur products. He/she marks, cuts, shapes and trims textile, light leather and other materials according to blueprints or specifications in the manufacture of garments, hats and caps, gloves and miscellaneous products.

occupations.title: Upholsterer and related worker
occupations.definition: Upholsterer and related worker installs, repairs and replaces upholstery of furniture, fixtures, orthopaedic appliances; seats, panels, convertible and vinyl tops and other furnishings of automobiles, railway coaches, aircraft, ships and similar items with fabric, leather, rexine or other upholstery material. He/she also makes and repairs cushions, quilts and mattresses.

occupations.title: Shoemaker/Cobbler
occupations.definition: Shoemaker/Cobbler makes complete or repairs standard footwear, mainly of leather, for individual customers. He/she takes measurements of feet and selects and adapts last, makes patterns and selects materials, cuts out various parts by hand or machine. He/she may also remove old parts of the footwear and clean surfaces. He/she glues lining to leather parts and sews them together, and pulls upper onto last to give it required shape. He/she fixes sole to upper, builds up and fixes heels, trims and smooths footwear and applies inked wax, stain or paint where required.

occupations.title: Leather goods maker/assembler
occupations.definition: Leather goods maker/assembler makes, by hand and machine, a variety of products consisting mainly of real or artificial leather, such as handbags, wallets, luggage, brief cases, belting, footballs and leather novelties.

occupations.title: Shoemaker and related worker n.e.c.
occupations.definition: This group covers shoemaker and related worker not elsewhere classified.

unit_groups.title: Garment, Leather and Related Trades Workers Not Elsewhere Classified

occupations.title: Garment/Leather and related trades worker n.e.c.
occupations.definition: This group covers garment/leather and related trades worker not elsewhere classified.

occupations.title: Underwater diver
occupations.definition: Underwater diver works under the surface of water, with or without the aid of underwater breathing apparatus, to inspect, install, repair and remove equipment and structures, conduct tests or experiments, rig explosives, photograph structures or marine life, collect various forms of aquatic life for commercial or research purposes, and find and recover missing items and persons.

unit_groups.title: Fumigator and Related Pest and Weed Controllers

occupations.title: Fumigator and related pest/weed controller
occupations.definition: Fumigator and related pest/weed controller uses chemicals to remove harmful insects, small animals, wild plants and other unwanted organisms, to prevent damage to crops and to buildings and other structures and their surroundings, and to prevent health risks.

unit_groups.title: Craft and Related Workers Not Elsewhere Classified

occupations.title: Craft and related worker n.e.c.
occupations.definition: This group covers craft and related worker not elsewhere classified.

major_groups.title: PLANT AND MACHINE OPERATORS AND ASSEMBLERS

minor_groups.title: STATIONARY PLANT AND MACHINE SUPERVISORS AND GENERAL FOREMEN

unit_groups.title: Stationary Plant and Machine Supervisors and General Foremen

occupations.title: Stationary plant/machine supervisor/general foreman
occupations.definition: Stationary plant/machine supervisor/general foreman supervises production activities of a distinct unit at a well drilling site, or an establishment engaged in processing of mineral ore and stone, metal, wood, or chemicals, or an establishment concerned with the production and distribution of electricity, steam or gas, or with water supply, sewage disposal and treatment, or with refrigeration and assimilated services, or within an establishment in which machines are used in the manufacturing of various products on an industrial basis. He/she controls and coordinates the activities of workers in various occupations.
exclusions: Assembly and quality check supervisor, see 82000
Electronic equipment manufacturing and repairing general foreman, see 82000

minor_groups.title: MINING AND MINERAL PROCESSING PLANT OPERATORS

unit_groups.title: Well Drillers and Borers and Related Mining Workers

occupations.title: Well driller/borer and related mining worker
occupations.definition: Well driller/borer and related mining worker operates, assembles and monitors machines for cutting channels in a mine workface or for the drilling and sinking of wells, extraction of ore, liquids and gases or for a variety of other purposes.

unit_groups.title: Cement and Related Mineral Products Machine Operators

occupations.title: Cement and related mineral products machine operator
occupations.definition: Cement and related mineral products machine operator operates and monitors machines for manufacturing and finishing precast concrete, bitumen and making cast stone for building purposes.

minor_groups.title: METAL PROCESSING, FINISHING AND PRODUCTS PLANT OPERATORS

unit_groups.title: Metal Melters, Casters and Rolling Mill Operators

occupations.title: Metal melter/caster/rolling mill operator
occupations.definition: Metal melter/caster/rolling mill operator operates, monitors, adjusts and maintains single-function machinery and equipment to process and convert mineral ores, cast or roll metals.

occupations.title: Metal heat treating plant operator
occupations.definition: Metal heat treating plant operator operates, monitors, adjusts and maintains machinery and equipment to treat and process metals.

occupations.title: Metal drawer/extruder
occupations.definition: Metal drawer/extruder draws and extrudes metals through dies to make wire, pipes, tubes and similar products.

unit_groups.title: Metal Finishing, Plating and Coating Machine Operators

occupations.title: Metal finishing/plating/coating machine operator
occupations.definition: Metal finishing/plating/coating machine operator operates and monitors equipment which finishes, plates and coats metal articles or parts, in order to give them improved resistance to corrosion and abrasion, for decorative purposes, or to impart electrical or magnetic properties.
exclusions: Spray painter (excluding ships and motor vehicles), see 71323

occupations.title: Metalworking machine setter-operator
occupations.definition: Metalworking machine setter-operator sets up and operates a variety of power-driven precision metal-cutting machines and tools, such as lathes, milling, planing and boring machines.

occupations.title: Precision grinding machine setter-operator
occupations.definition: Precision grinding machine setter-operator sets up, programmes and controls grinding machines to remove small amounts of excess material and smoothen metal workpieces by using an abrasive wheel with diamond teeth as a cutting device for very precise and light cuts. He/she reads grinding machine blueprints and tooling instructions, performs regular machine maintenance, and makes adjustments to the grinding controls, such as the depth of cuts and the rotation speed.
exclusions: Metal buffing and polishing machine operator, see 72240

occupations.title: Machine-tool setter-operator n.e.c.
occupations.definition: This group covers machine-tool setter-operator not elsewhere classified.

minor_groups.title: CHEMICAL PROCESSING, CHEMICAL AND PHOTOGRAPHIC PRODUCTS PLANT AND MACHINE OPERATORS

unit_groups.title: Chemical Processing and Products Plant and Machine Operators

occupations.title: Chemical processing/products plant/machine operator
occupations.definition: Chemical processing/products plant/machine operator monitors and operates units and machinery to blend, mix, process and package a wide range of chemical products (excluding pharmaceutical products).
exclusions: Chemical engineering technician (excluding petroleum, natural gas and petrochemical), see 31161

occupations.title: Pharmaceutical products machine operator
occupations.definition: Pharmaceutical products machine operator monitors and operates units and machinery to blend, mix, process and package a wide range of pharmaceutical products.

occupations.title: Photographic products machine operator
occupations.definition: Photographic products machine operator operates and monitors equipment which makes photographic film and paper and which processes exposed photographic film and makes prints.

unit_groups.title: Chemical Processing, Chemical and Photographic Products Plant and Machine Operators Not Elsewhere Classified

occupations.title: Chemical processing/chemical/photographic products plant/machine operator n.e.c.
occupations.definition: This group covers chemical processing/chemical/photographic products plant/machine operator not elsewhere classified.

minor_groups.title: RUBBER, PLASTIC AND PAPER PRODUCTS MACHINE OPERATORS

occupations.title: Rubber products machine operator
occupations.definition: Rubber products machine operator monitors and operates machines which knead and blend rubber and rubber compounds to produce various components and products from natural and synthetic rubber, such as moulded footwear, domestic articles, insulating materials, industrial accessories or tyres.

occupations.title: Plastic products machine operator
occupations.definition: Plastic products machine operator monitors and operates machines which knead and blend compounds to obtain plastic materials, which make various plastic components and articles. He/she may operate and monitor machines which laminate plastics and plastic impregnated materials or may encase uncoated wire, cord, cable and optic fibre in plastic.

unit_groups.title: Paper and Paperboard Products Machine Operators

occupations.title: Paper/Paperboard products machine operator
occupations.definition: Paper/Paperboard products machine operator monitors and operates machines which produce boxes, envelopes, bags and other goods from paper, paperboard and other similar materials.
examples: Paper box cutting and creasing press operator

minor_groups.title: TEXTILE, FUR AND LEATHER PRODUCTS MACHINE OPERATORS

unit_groups.title: Textile, Fur and Leather Products Machine Operators

occupations.title: Sewing machine operator
occupations.definition: Sewing machine operator operates and monitors sewing machines to make, repair, darn and renovate textile, fur, synthetic or leather garments or embroider ornamental designs on garments or non garment products. He/she operates button hole making and eyelet holing machines to cut holes, stitch around holes, stitch buttons and fix eyelets to garments.

occupations.title: Laundry/Dry cleaning worker (machine, non-household)
occupations.definition: Laundry/Dry cleaning worker (machine, non-household) operates and monitors machines that use chemicals to wash or dry-clean articles such as cloth and leather garments, linens, drapes or carpets, ensuring the colour and texture of these articles are being maintained. He/she sorts the articles received from clients by fabric type and determines the cleaning technique to be applied.

occupations.title: Textile/Fur/Leather products machine operator n.e.c.
occupations.definition: This group covers textile/fur/leather products machine operator not elsewhere classified.

minor_groups.title: FOOD AND RELATED PRODUCTS MACHINE OPERATORS

unit_groups.title: Food and Related Products Machine Operators

occupations.title: Meat/Fish products machine operator
occupations.definition: Meat/Fish products machine operator operates machines and performs routine tasks to make various kinds of meat and fish products, such as sausages and fishballs. He/she weighs out various ingredients according to the recipes and minces, mixes and combines the ingredients using machine.

occupations.title: Dairy/Confectionery products machine operator
occupations.definition: Dairy/Confectionery products machine operator sets up and operates continuous flow or vat-type equipment to process milk, cheese, ice cream, and other dairy products following specific instructions, methods and formulas.

occupations.title: Baked/Cereal products machine operator
occupations.definition: Baked/Cereal products machine operator makes baked products or cereal based products, such as biscuits and noodles and pasta, with the use of machines.

occupations.title: Brewer/Wine and related beverages machine operator
occupations.definition: Brewer/Wine and related beverages machine operator sets, operates and attends to machinery used to process and produce beer, wines, malt liquors, coffee, tea, syrup and other beverages.

occupations.title: Food and related products machine operator n.e.c.
occupations.definition: This group covers food and related products machine operator not elsewhere classified.

minor_groups.title: WOOD PROCESSING AND PAPERMAKING PLANT OPERATORS

unit_groups.title: Wood Processing and Papermaking Plant Operators

occupations.title: Wood processing/Papermaking plant operator
occupations.definition: Wood processing/Papermaking plant operator monitors, operates and controls machinery to saw wood, cut veneer, make plywood, produce pulp and paper and to otherwise prepare wood, pulp and paper for further use.

minor_groups.title: OTHER STATIONARY PLANT AND MACHINE OPERATORS

occupations.title: Glass/Ceramics plant operator
occupations.definition: Glass/Ceramics plant operator operates machines used in the manufacture of glass, ceramics, fibreglass filaments, porcelain, tiles or bricks. He/she operates machines to anneal, harden or decorate glass and ceramics. He/she may set and maintain the furnace temperature, start the machine and observe the process to detect defects.
exclusions: Plastic goods casting machine operator, see 81420

occupations.title: Boiler fireman
occupations.definition: Boiler fireman tends one or more boilers which produce steam for heat or power. He/she controls valves to maintain the required level of water in boiler, shovels fuel into fireboxes and pokes the fire to obtain maximum heat or sets devices which feed gas, oil or other fuel automatically. He/she checks the temperature and pressure of steam by reading gauges and feeds fuel or adjusts the stoking mechanism accordingly. He/she may remove ashes from ash pans, clean boilers and flues, and condition boiler water by adding chemicals.

occupations.title: Ship’s oiler/greaser
occupations.definition: Ship’s oiler/greaser lubricates bearings and moving parts of engines and other mechanical equipment on vessels afloat. He/she makes regular rounds of machinery, checks gauges and thermometers and adjusts pressure and flow of lubricants to working parts of machinery. He/she also pours oil and applies grease with grease-guns at specified points of machinery not automatically lubricated. He/she assists engineers and engine-room mechanics in overhauling and repairing engines and other shipboard machinery.

occupations.title: Steam engine/boiler operator n.e.c.
occupations.definition: This group covers steam engine/boiler operator not elsewhere classified.

unit_groups.title: Packing, Bottling and Labelling Machine Operators

occupations.title: Packing/Bottling/Labelling machine operator
occupations.definition: Packing/Bottling/Labelling machine operator monitors and operates machines which weigh, pack and label various products or fill different containers with products.

unit_groups.title: Printing, Binding and Related Machine Operators

occupations.title: Printing machine operator
occupations.definition: Printing machine operator monitors and operates various types of printing and copying machines which print and copy onto paper.

occupations.title: Bookbinding machine operator
occupations.definition: Bookbinding machine operator performs a series of tasks in binding books with machines. He/she sews together signatures to form book bodies with a sewing machine, compresses sewn-together signatures of book bodies to uniform thickness with a smashing machine, trims books to size with a powered cutting machine, inserts each book into a machine which rounds backs and forms grooves at the back edge in which covers are hinged, stacks and aligns books, glues the superlining and back-lining on each book, glues the cover to the end sheets, and places books in a press to dry.

occupations.title: Printing/Binding and related machine operator n.e.c.
occupations.definition: This group covers printing/binding and related machine operator not elsewhere classified.

unit_groups.title: Stationary Plant and Machine Operators Not Elsewhere Classified

occupations.title: Stationary plant/machine operator n.e.c.
occupations.definition: This group covers stationary plant/machine operator not elsewhere classified.
examples: Container filling machine operator (excluding compressed and liquefied gas)

minor_groups.title: SUPERVISORS AND GENERAL FOREMEN OF ASSEMBLERS AND QUALITY CHECKERS

unit_groups.title: Supervisors and General Foremen of Assemblers and Quality Checkers

occupations.title: Supervisor/General foreman of assemblers/quality checkers
occupations.definition: Supervisor/General foreman of assemblers/quality checkers supervises the production activities of a distinct unit within an establishment concerned with manufacturing and assembling electrical and electronic equipment and components and controls and coordinates the activities of workers.
examples: Electrical equipment manufacturing and repairing supervisor
Electronic equipment manufacturing and repairing general foreman

occupations.title: Mechanical equipment/component assembler
occupations.definition: Mechanical equipment/component assembler assembles, according to procedures strictly laid down, component parts of mechanical machinery such as engines, motor vehicles, turbines and aircraft.

occupations.title: Electrical equipment/component assembler
occupations.definition: Electrical equipment/component assembler assembles various parts into finished electrical components, sub-assemblies or machinery and apparatus. He/she assembles parts or mounts them on chassis by means of adjusting, fitting, wiring, positioning and/or welding operations using assembly equipment.

occupations.title: Electronic equipment/component assembler
occupations.definition: Electronic equipment/component assembler assembles various parts into finished electronic components, sub-assemblies or equipment. He/she installs and connects wiring and parts by clamping or soldering.

occupations.title: Battery assembler
occupations.definition: Battery assembler assembles cells and other components in a container (battery case) to make a complete storage battery. He/she inserts cells into containers according to the prescribed polarity arrangement, installs covers on cells and fits intercell connectors on posts. He/she burns connectors to posts, pours compound over cells to fill cracks and seal the battery in the case.

occupations.title: Electrical/Electronic products quality checker/tester
occupations.definition: Electrical/Electronic products quality checker/tester inspects and tests electrical or electronic equipment for conformance to manufacturer’s standards. He/she checks equipment and parts according to technical specifications, rejects faulty products and records information on inspection tickets. He/she may inspect mechanical operation of equipment and may inspect components and equipment in various stages of production.

occupations.title: Mechanical products quality checker/tester
occupations.definition: Mechanical products quality checker/tester inspects and tests machinery and related mechanical equipment for finish, mechanical operation and conformance to manufacturer standards. He/she may do minor adjustments and may inspect articles in various stages of production.

occupations.title: Quality checker/tester n.e.c.
occupations.definition: This group covers quality checker/tester not elsewhere classified.

occupations.title: Assembler n.e.c.
occupations.definition: This group covers assembler not elsewhere classified.

minor_groups.title: MOBILE MACHINERY SUPERVISORS AND GENERAL FOREMEN

unit_groups.title: Mobile Machinery Supervisors and General Foremen

occupations.title: Mobile machinery supervisor/general foreman
occupations.definition: Mobile machinery supervisor/general foreman supervises activities of a distinct unit within an establishment concerned with the transport of passengers, material and goods and controls the activities of workers in related occupations.

occupations.title: Train operator
occupations.definition: Train operator drives trains to transport passengers and goods. He/she watches for track hazards, observes signals and indicator gauges and operates communication systems to communicate with train crews and traffic controllers to ensure safe operation and scheduling of trains.

occupations.title: Railway braker and related worker
occupations.definition: Railway braker and related worker assists in preparing train for run, safeguards train during trip and switches cars. He/she checks car mechanisms such as couplings, air-brake lines and hand brakes before train departure, examines signalling equipment such as lamps, flags, detonators and fuses, observes train operation to detect over-heated journal boxes, loose couplings or other defects.

minor_groups.title: CAR AND LIGHT GOODS VEHICLE DRIVERS

occupations.title: Motorcycle delivery worker
occupations.definition: Motorcycle delivery worker transports and delivers non-mail items by motorcycle.

occupations.title: Delivery worker using motorised personal mobility aids/devices
occupations.definition: Delivery worker using motorised personal mobility aids/devices transports and delivers non-mail items by motorised personal mobility aids/devices.
examples: Motorised personal mobility device (PMD) delivery man

unit_groups.title: Car, Taxi, Van and Light Goods Vehicle Drivers

occupations.title: Taxi driver
occupations.definition: Taxi driver drives a motorised vehicle to transport passengers on demand at a charge usually based on a meter fare, from one point to another. He/she does not have a fixed route to drive around and he/she also assists passengers boarding or leaving the vehicle.

occupations.title: Chauffeur
occupations.definition: Chauffeur drives a motorised vehicle to transport personnel and visitors of businesses, government or other organisations or members of private households. He/she is usually employed by businesses, government and other organisations, or private individuals or families.

occupations.title: Van driver
occupations.definition: Van driver drives a van to pick up and deliver non-mail documents and parcels.

occupations.title: Ambulance driver
occupations.definition: Ambulance driver drives an ambulance vehicle to carry sick, injured and emergency cases to hospital in a safe, efficient and courteous manner. He/she places the patient on a stretcher and loads the stretcher into the ambulance, coordinates transport requests including handling of patient transfers to other hospitals.

occupations.title: Parking valet
occupations.definition: Parking valet provides assistance to clients by moving their vehicles to a specific parking location. He/she may provide information on parking rates.

occupations.title: Private-hire car driver
occupations.definition: Private-hire car driver drives a motorised vehicle to transport passengers on a pre-booked basis and charges a fixed fare, usually a flat fare. He/she does not pick passengers up via street hails and does not drive around a fixed route.

occupations.title: Car/Taxi/Van/Light goods vehicle driver n.e.c.
occupations.definition: This group covers car/taxi/van/light goods vehicle driver not elsewhere classified.

occupations.title: Bus driver
occupations.definition: Bus driver drives a bus to transport passengers. He/she adheres to service routes schedules and complies with transportation and traffic rules and regulations. He/she responds to incidents or accidents as per advice by Bus Operation Control Centre and provides customer service to commuters to enhance service delivery on board buses, e.g. assist wheelchair commuters to board/alight the bus safely.

occupations.title: Tram driver
occupations.definition: Tram driver operates a tram along the designated route and may need to provide live commentary to enhance the guest experience.

occupations.title: Lorry driver
occupations.definition: Lorry driver drives a heavy motor vehicle such as a lorry for the transport of passengers and freight. He/she may assist with delivering parcels and documents. He/she may make minor repairs and keep the vehicle clean and in good running order.

occupations.title: Trailer-truck driver
occupations.definition: Trailer-truck driver drives a tractor-trailer combination or a truck or a tow truck. He/she may assist with unloading the trailer-truck.

occupations.title: Concrete mix truck driver
occupations.definition: Concrete mix truck driver drives and operates trucks to haul concrete from the plant to project sites, and operates pumps to disperse concrete at the site. He/she cleans and maintains the truck and its mechanical parts.

occupations.title: Waste truck driver
occupations.definition: Waste truck driver drives large vehicles used for refuse collection. He/she drives the vehicles from the homes and facilities where the refuse is collected by the refuse collectors on the lorry and transports the waste to the waste treatment and disposal facilities.
examples: Hooklift trucks with roll-on container driver

occupations.title: Heavy truck/Lorry driver n.e.c.
occupations.definition: This group covers heavy truck/lorry driver not elsewhere classified.

unit_groups.title: Earth Moving and Related Machinery Operators

occupations.title: Excavating/Trench digging machine operator
occupations.definition: Excavating/Trench digging machine operator operates a power-driven machine, mounted on wheels or crawler tracks, equipped with a moveable shovel, grab-bucket or dragline bucket to excavate and move earth, rock, sand, gravel and similar material. He/she may operate a particular type of machine and be designated accordingly. He/she also conducts pre-operational checks on equipment to ensure proper functioning.

occupations.title: Dredge operator
occupations.definition: Dredge operator operates various kinds of excavating equipment, mounted on a dredge, to remove sand, gravel and mud from the bottom of a body of water. He/she watches the tide gauge and adjusts the mechanism to keep work uniform. He/she may make minor repairs.

occupations.title: Pile driver/drilling machine operator
occupations.definition: Pile driver/drilling machine operator operates a power-driven machine equipped with a power hammer or drop-hammer to drive wooden, concrete or steel piles into dry ground or the bottom of a body of water. He/she hoists the pile and lowers it into position for driving, manipulates controls to operate the hammer, makes adjustments to the hoisting engine and hammer and assists in maintaining the machine.

occupations.title: Tunnelling machine operator
occupations.definition: Tunnelling machine operator works on large pieces of tunnelling equipment commonly known as tunnel boring machines. He/she regulates the operation of the machine, adjusting the torque of the rotating cutting wheel and screw conveyor to maximise the stability of the tunnel before tunnel rings are installed. He/she also puts reinforced concrete rings in place using remote controls.

occupations.title: Earth moving and related machinery operator n.e.c.
occupations.definition: This group covers earth moving and related machinery operator not elsewhere classified.

unit_groups.title: Crane, Hoist and Related Equipment Operators

occupations.title: Crane/Hoist operator (excluding port)
occupations.definition: Crane/Hoist operator (excluding port) operates a crane mounted on wheels or crawler tracks which can be moved under its own power in any direction. He/she operates power-driven hoisting equipment, usually consisting of a mobile cage or platform, to raise and lower materials and workers employed on construction work. He/she loads or oversees the loading of the cage, platform or other device connected to hoist.

occupations.title: Crane operator (on-site)
occupations.definition: Crane operator (on-site) operates port machinery such as quay cranes, yard cranes, fork lifts and prime movers in a safe and efficient manner that complies with port regulations while ensuring all cargo and ship supplies are discharged and loaded. He/she also inspects the equipment and work site prior to equipment set up based on his/her thorough understanding of the equipment’s specifications.

occupations.title: Crane/Hoist and related equipment operator n.e.c.
occupations.definition: This group covers crane/hoist and related equipment operator not elsewhere classified.

occupations.title: Fork lift truck operator
occupations.definition: Fork lift truck operator operates power-driven trucks equipped with a fork lift or lifting platform to pick up, transport and raise or mechanically stack bales, crates, cartons and similar objects in a warehouse, storeroom, factory or other establishment. He/she exercises care to prevent damage to goods. He/she may carry out routine servicing of trucks, tow hand trucks and load or unload trucks.

occupations.title: Lifting truck operator n.e.c.
occupations.definition: This group covers lifting truck operator not elsewhere classified.
exclusions: Hooklift trucks with roll-on container driver, see 83324

unit_groups.title: Mobile Machinery Operators Not Elsewhere Classified

occupations.title: Motorised sweeper operator
occupations.definition: Motorised sweeper operator operates and monitors mobile machinery to clean roads and pavements, and perform other duties to ensure public cleanliness.

occupations.title: Airport mobile equipment operator
occupations.definition: Airport mobile equipment operator drives and operates heavy or light motorised equipment such as tow-trucks, mobile gangways and other specified equipment used at airports for loading and unloading of passengers and goods, towing and servicing aircraft etc. He/she also maintains equipment and checks for serviceability.

occupations.title: Other mobile machinery operator n.e.c.
occupations.definition: This group covers other mobile machinery operator not elsewhere classified.

minor_groups.title: SHIPS’ DECK CREW AND RELATED WORKERS

unit_groups.title: Ships’ Deck Crew and Related Workers

occupations.title: Port limit helmsman/steersman/engine driver/tugmaster
occupations.definition: Port limit helmsman/steersman/engine driver/tugmaster manoeuvres and handles boats or crafts ferrying ship agents and seafarers between ships and shore, ferrying harbour pilots to board commercial ships, and transporting and supplying ship stores and provisions to ships at anchorages. He/she maintains and services the ship’s engine while ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements and organisational procedures.

occupations.title: Deckhand
occupations.definition: Deckhand serves as senior deck-hand on a seagoing vessel. He/she stands lookout, steers the vessel as directed, handles mooring lines on board, lowers and raises lifeboats, and takes charge of lifeboats and other small boats. He/she also maintains lifeboats, life-saving gear, deck equipment and makes minor repairs, scrapes and cleans painted surfaces of the vessel and repaints them. He/she washes decks and maintains cleanliness of the ship’s hull, fittings, superstructure and cargo spaces.

occupations.title: Ship’s deck crew and related worker n.e.c.
occupations.definition: This group covers ship’s deck crew and related worker not elsewhere classified.

occupations.title: Cleaning supervisor
occupations.definition: Cleaning supervisor supervises the activities of a unit performing various cleaning tasks in private households, hotels, offices, hospitals and other establishments, as well as in aircrafts, trains and similar vehicles, in order to keep the interiors and fixtures clean. He/she ensures service quality delivery and safety and assists in the planning of cleaning operations work plans, incident management and manages inventory of cleaning equipment and materials used in project sites.

minor_groups.title: CLEANERS AND HELPERS IN HOTELS, OFFICES AND OTHER ESTABLISHMENTS

unit_groups.title: Cleaners and Helpers in Hotels and Related Establishments

occupations.title: Housekeeping/Linen room attendant
occupations.definition: Housekeeping/Linen room attendant performs any combination of light cleaning duties to maintain private households or commercial establishments, such as hotels and hospitals, in a clean and orderly manner. He/she may make beds, replenish linens, clean rooms and halls, and do vacuuming.

occupations.title: Hotel cleaner
occupations.definition: Hotel cleaner performs cleaning duties to keep the hotel building in a clean and orderly condition. He/she cleans floors, shampoos rugs, washes walls and glass, and removes rubbish. He/she may also perform routine maintenance activities, and notify management of need for the repairs.

occupations.title: Cleaner/Helper in hotel and related establishment n.e.c.
occupations.definition: This group covers cleaner/helper in hotel and related establishment not elsewhere classified.

unit_groups.title: Cleaners in Offices, Commercial and Industrial Establishments

occupations.title: Office/Commercial/Industrial establishment indoor cleaner
occupations.definition: Office/Commercial/Industrial establishment indoor cleaner works in a sheltered environment, cleans and keeps in orderly condition the interior of office, commercial and industrial establishments, including places of worship, hospitals, schools, shopping malls etc. He/she wipes tables and windows, disposes waste or litter, vacuums carpets and cleans pantry. He/she may also be required to do outdoor cleaning on a routine basis.

occupations.title: Office/Commercial/Industrial establishment outdoor cleaner
occupations.definition: Office/Commercial/Industrial establishment outdoor cleaner works in an unsheltered environment, cleans and keeps in orderly condition the outdoor compound areas of office, commercial and industrial establishments, including places of worship, hospitals, schools, shopping malls etc. He/she sweeps car parks, mops lifts and lift landing and clears trash bins.

occupations.title: Office/Commercial/Industrial establishment multi-skilled cleaner cum machine operator
occupations.definition: Office/Commercial/Industrial establishment multi-skilled cleaner cum machine operator uses motorised ride-on machinery (e.g. ride-on road sweeper, integrated scrubber-sweeper), lifting equipment (e.g. scissor lift, boomlift), various handheld machines (e.g. burnisher, single-disc scrubber, hi-pressure jet machine) or specialised cleaning agents to clean office, commercial and industrial establishments, including places of worship, hospitals, schools, shopping malls etc. He/she shampoos carpet, polishes marble, blows leaves and uses motorised equipment to sweep and clean high areas.
examples: Factory multi-skilled cleaner cum machine operator

unit_groups.title: Cleaners in Food and Beverage Establishments

occupations.title: Food and beverage establishment general cleaner
occupations.definition: Food and beverage establishment general cleaner cleans tables, removes dirty dishes, replaces soiled table linens and sets tables. He/she replenishes the supply of clean linens, silverware, glassware, and dishes.

occupations.title: Table-top cleaner
occupations.definition: Table-top cleaner collects plates, trays and utensils and cleans tables. He/she may station at the tray-return station to perform such tasks.
exclusions: Food and beverage (F&B) establishment general cleaner, see 91151

occupations.title: Dishwasher
occupations.definition: Dishwasher washes plates, trays and utensils and pushes cart in and out of dishwashing bay. He/she may operate dishwashing machine and use conveyor belts in the transportation of plates, trays and utensils.

occupations.title: Food and beverage establishment multi-skilled cleaner cum machine operator
occupations.definition: Food and beverage establishment multi-skilled cleaner cum machine operator uses motorised ride-on machinery (e.g. ride-on road sweeper, integrated scrubber-sweeper), lifting equipment (e.g. scissor lift, boomlift), various handheld machines (e.g. burnisher, single-disc scrubber, hi-pressure jet machine) or specialised cleaning agents to clean the premises of food and beverage establishments.

unit_groups.title: Cleaners in Residential and Open Areas

occupations.title: Residential/Open areas general cleaner
occupations.definition: Residential/Open areas general cleaner cleans and tidies the premises of residential areas and common public open areas such as roads, pavements, bus stops, drains, waterways, overhead bridges, expressways, parks, beaches etc. He/she sweeps residential and open areas and disposes of litter and waste.
exclusions: Conservancy multi-skilled cleaner cum machine operator, see 91162

occupations.title: Residential/Open areas multi-skilled cleaner cum machine operator
occupations.definition: Residential/Open areas multi-skilled cleaner cum machine operator uses motorised ride-on machinery (e.g. ride-on road sweeper, integrated scrubber-sweeper), lifting equipment (e.g. scissor lift, boomlift), various handheld machines (e.g. burnisher, single-disc scrubber, hi-pressure jet machine) or specialised cleaning agents to clean and tidy the premises of residential areas and common public open areas such as roads, pavements, bus stops, drains, waterways, overhead bridges, expressways, parks, beaches etc. He/she operates sweeping equipment and machinery to remove waste, leaves or debris and maintains, cleans and performs minor repairs to the equipment used.
examples: Conservancy multi-skilled cleaner cum machine operator

minor_groups.title: VEHICLE, WINDOW, LAUNDRY AND OTHER HAND CLEANING WORKERS

occupations.title: Hand launderer/presser (non-household)
occupations.definition: Hand launderer/presser (non-household) washes, dry-cleans and irons clothing, bedding, upholstery and similar articles, using cleaning agents, steam irons, vacuum pressers, or hand pressers. He/she receives articles, marks them for identification and sorts soiled articles according to type and treatment to be given.
examples: Laundry and dry cleaning worker (manual, non-household)

occupations.title: Motor vehicle cleaner/polisher
occupations.definition: Motor vehicle cleaner/polisher washes, cleans and polishes motor vehicles such as cars, taxis, motorcycles. He/she cleans and polishes surfaces of external parts and interiors of vehicles, using water, cleaning agents, brushes and cloths.

occupations.title: Window cleaner
occupations.definition: Window cleaner washes and polishes windows and other glass fittings. He/she uses cleaning tools such as sponges and detergents to clean and polish windows, mirrors and other glass surfaces of buildings, both on the interior and exterior. He/she uses specific ladders to clean taller buildings with safety belts for support.

occupations.title: Ship/Ship tank cleaner
occupations.definition: Ship/Ship tank cleaner cleans water, fuel, cargo and bilge tanks on ships using hoses, chemical solvents and specialised equipment.

occupations.title: Aircraft cleaner
occupations.definition: Aircraft cleaner cleans the interior and exterior of aircraft. He/she prepares and maintains cleaning equipment and tools, cleans and dresses aircraft cabins according to airline specifications. He/she may assist in moving aircraft components, equipment and materials from the store to the respective work areas.

occupations.title: Railway carriage cleaner
occupations.definition: Railway carriage cleaner cleans interior and exterior of railway carriage.

occupations.title: Other cleaning worker n.e.c.
occupations.definition: This group covers other cleaning worker not elsewhere classified.

occupations.title: Domestic helper/cleaner
occupations.definition: Domestic helper/cleaner sweeps, vacuum-cleans, washes and polishes, takes care of household linen, purchases household supplies, prepares food, serves meals and performs various other domestic duties. He/she may also look after babies and elderly in the household.
exclusions: Laundry and dry cleaning worker (manual, non-household), see 91210

unit_groups.title: Park, Garden and Landscape Maintenance Workers

occupations.title: Tree worker/technician
occupations.definition: Tree worker/technician prunes or treats trees or shrubs using handsaws, hand pruners, clippers, and power pruners. He/she works off the ground in the tree canopy and may use truck-mounted lifts or climbing and rigging tools.

occupations.title: Landscape worker
occupations.definition: Landscape worker performs tasks to support and execute landscape maintenance as per instructions provided and under supervision. He/she performs maintenance tasks such as watering, fertilising, weeding, soil aeration, plant pruning and grass cutting, clearing of horticultural waste and plant pest and disease control for allocated portions of a landscape site. He/she also performs routine maintenance of tools and equipment. He/she may be involved in nursery work or arboricultural maintenance as well.

occupations.title: Park/Garden/Landscape maintenance worker n.e.c.
occupations.definition: This group covers park/garden/landscape maintenance worker not elsewhere classified.

unit_groups.title: Agricultural, Fishery and Related Labourers Not Elsewhere Classified

occupations.title: Agricultural/Fishery and related labourer n.e.c.
occupations.definition: This group covers agricultural/fishery and related labourer not elsewhere classified.

unit_groups.title: Civil Engineering and Building Construction Labourers

occupations.title: Civil engineering/Building construction labourer
occupations.definition: Civil engineering/Building construction labourer performs routine tasks in connection with demolition works as well as the construction of buildings and civil engineering projects such as roads, railways and dams. He/she performs tasks involving physical labour such as cleans and prepares sites, digs trenches, sets braces to support excavation sites, erects scaffolding and cleans up rubble and debris. He/she may operate hand and power tools such as cement mixers and small mechanical hoists.

occupations.title: Hand packer
occupations.definition: Hand packer packs materials or products by hand in cartons, wooden boxes, crates, kegs and other containers for shipment or storage. He/she wraps articles in paper, shavings, corrugated cardboard, cloth or other material and folds, stacks, arranges or secures articles in containers. He/she may clean surfaces before packing, brush heavy oil on metal articles to prevent rust, seal containers, reinforce containers with wire or metal bands and mark or label containers.

occupations.title: Manufacturing labourer and related worker n.e.c.
occupations.definition: This group covers manufacturing labourer and related worker not elsewhere classified.

occupations.title: Hand/Pedal vehicle driver
occupations.definition: Hand/Pedal vehicle driver propels cycles and similar vehicles to transport passengers or goods. He/she also maintains vehicles in good running order and does minor repair.
exclusions: Motorised personal mobility device (PMD) delivery man, see 83212

occupations.title: Stevedore
occupations.definition: Stevedore loads and unloads ships’ cargoes. He/she carries goods from the quayside into the ship’s hold, or vice versa, or places them in position for removal by mechanical means and stows cargo in position in the hold. He/she may load and unload trucks, count, weigh, measure goods, and mark information on them for identification.

occupations.title: Railway/Road vehicle loader
occupations.definition: Railway/Road vehicle loader loads and unloads goods carried in trucks, wagons and other vehicles by hand, using hand trucks, skids, bars jacks and similar equipment. He/she also stows articles to form a compact load and to avoid damage in transit and facilitate unloading. He/she may secure loads with ropes or other fastenings, place padding on articles to prevent breakage and secure wagon covers.

occupations.title: Aircraft loader
